transcript:
I wonder if you are destined to be forgotten. Will your life fade in the shadow of greater beings?
Damn you all! Why do I fight over this place when my plans may be laid anywhere? I must start anew!
DIE!
Enough, I will no longer listen to the babbling of ignorant children.
No one foresaw it, but with study we can prevent it happening again.
Of course, I will see to it as quickly as possible.
Silence, dog, you have no purpose but to die by my hand.
You disappointed me.
source: David Warner · Baldur’s Gate II dialogue soundset
